description: Store a logo for the workspace so it can be put on photos later. It does not change any photo by itself: pass the returned `id` to generate_background as `logo.id`, or as `license_plate_logo.id` for a `plate` logo. The file is fetched from `image_url` once and a copy is kept (PNG, WebP or JPEG up to 5 MB; a transparent background works best). `type` is `logo` (default) for dealer logos or `plate` for license plate designs, where `background` sets the plate colour behind a transparent logo. Up to seven per type: when full, remove one with delete_logo first. Check list_logos before uploading to avoid duplicates. Free. Returns the stored logo with its `id`.

background.description: Plate logos only: hex colour behind a transparent logo. Default white.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the logo.

type.description: `logo` (default): logos drawn on finished photos. `plate`: designs put on the license plate.

name: upload_logo
title: Upload logo
